licenses.text:
Біблія в пер. П.Куліша та І.Пулюя, 1905, eBible.org, https://ebible.org/ukr1871/

The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this translation, https://ebible.org/ukr1871/copyright.htm):
> The Holy Bible in Ukrainian, translated by P. Kulish and I. Pulyu in 1905
> Public Domain
> Language: Українська (Ukrainian)
> Translation by: Panteleimon Kulish
> Contributor: Ivan Semenovych Nechui-Levytsky, Ivan Pavlovych Puluj
> Повідомте про помилки тут: https://forms.gle/PAo2uKZqCNnoZGDe7
> 2025-01-31

Why this is public domain:
Translators: Panteleimon Kulish 1819-1897, Ivan Puluj 1845-1918, Ivan Nechuy-Levytsky 1838-1918. Text: the complete Bible first published in 1903 in Vienna by the British and Foreign Bible Society; eBible's text keeps the old Kulish spelling, and no later reviser is named. US: published before 1931. Origin: Austria, life plus 70 years; the last translator died in 1918, so the term ended in 1988.

The read-aloud archive holds the Bible text chapter by chapter as plain text, a front file, the copyright page (copr.htm, left out of the source), and eBible.org's signing key (keys.asc, left out).

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page (https://ebible.org/details.php?id=ukr1871), the edition's copyright page (https://ebible.org/ukr1871/copyright.htm), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Panteleimon_Kulish; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ivan_Puluj; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ivan_Nechuy-Levytsky; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_countries%27_copyright_lengths; https://copyright.cornell.edu/publicdomain.

held_out_by.note: eBible's chapter files, <code>_<NNN>_<BOOK>_<CC>_read.txt, are held out by book and chapter, so the same chapter is held out in every translation at once (maintainer's decision, 2026-10-23)

note: eBible.org rebuilds this zip often; the checksum covers the files inside, so a rebuild with the same text still matches.
